# WC2 · Tìm bệnh nhân · không có hồ sơ

Group **WC · Hồ sơ & Patient 360** · state · Next.js: **built (U1)** (`/patients`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#patients`
- Patient 360 is `clinic.js › patient360()`: hero, tab bar (`data-tab`), then one body per tab. `care-finance.js` injects the linked service/prescription panels under every tab except `crm` and `history`.
- Empty state of `patients()`: "Không tìm thấy hồ sơ", "Thử tên, mã hồ sơ hoặc mối quan tâm khác." and a clear-search button.
- Page key `patients` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor, care, accountant (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"patients\"]"} → {"fill":["#patient-search","zzzz"]} → {"wait":"#clear-search"}; it must show "Không tìm thấy hồ sơ".

## Next.js target
- Route: `/patients` · status: **built (U1)** · U step: U1
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/patients` "Hồ sơ bệnh nhân" (owner U1); test ids: `src/lib/ops/format.test.ts`
- Existing page file: `pema-agent/frontend/src/app/(admin)/patients/page.tsx`

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Tìm bệnh nhân", page key "patients"
  <PageHeading title="Tìm bệnh nhân" subtitle="Tìm theo tên, mã hồ sơ, số điện thoại hoặc mối quan tâm.">
    <Button variant="primary" icon old="btn btn-primary">"Hồ sơ mới"</Button>  // modal=patient
  </PageHeading>
  <Row old="search-box" gap="12px">
    <Field label="Tìm tên, mã hoặc số điện thoại" type="text" placeholder="Ví dụ: Nguyễn Minh Linh, P001, nám..." default="zzzz" id="patient-search" />
    <Badge tone="neutral" old="chip">"0 hồ sơ"</Badge>
  </Row>
  <Row old="filter-row" gap="8px" wrap>
    <FilterChipGroup items={["Tất cả","Đang điều trị","Tái khám tuần này","Có cảnh báo"]} selected={[]} />  // patientFilter
  </Row>
  <Card old="panel">
    <EmptyState text={"⌕ Không tìm thấy hồ sơ Thử tên, mã hồ sơ hoặc mối quan tâm khác. Xóa tìm kiếm"}>
      <Text>"⌕"</Text>
      <Text strong>"Không tìm thấy hồ sơ"</Text>
      <Text>"Thử tên, mã hồ sơ hoặc mối quan tâm khác."</Text>
      <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Xóa tìm kiếm"</Button>
    </EmptyState>
  </Card>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×2, PageHeading×1, Field×1, Badge×1, Card×1, EmptyState×1; shared pieces: FilterChip×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- ⌕ Không tìm thấy hồ sơ Thử tên, mã hồ sơ hoặc mối quan tâm khác. Xóa tìm kiếm (empty state)

## Business rules
- Clinical actions need the `clinical` capability (owner, doctor); without it `action()` answers "Cần tài khoản bác sĩ để thực hiện." and `staff-context.js › apply()` removes the controls.
